Hi Erin / Samir — great call today, thanks for the time. This thread is a short post-call recap + proposed action grid so we can get the POC rolling next week. I pulled together the success criteria we discussed and mapped owners for the trial. Please scan and confirm anything you want changed.

Summary of objectives
- Validate inference economics and latency/throughput for your nightly summarization job (avg doc length ~2.8k tokens)
- Ensure quality meets the product bar for summarization (intent/accuracy and hallucination tolerances)
- Measure token cost at scale to inform internal pricing decisions

Proposed Success Criteria (gated)
1) Latency: p90 generation latency <= 850ms for typical 2.8k token input (sandbox workload) — measured at Redwood-hosted endpoint.
2) Throughput: sustained 180 requests/min (3 rps) with cold-starts under control; burst up to 12 rps for ingest windows.
3) Cost: baseline cost <= $0.0009 / token for the evaluated model/config (including batching/quantization) when averaged across 2-week run.
4) Quality: >= 92% of summaries pass HelioTech internal review as 'accept' (sample of 200 summaries, blind eval) and <5% critical hallucination rate.

Operational acceptance gates (must pass all to move to production-like trial):
- Delivery of sample dataset and golden labels (Samir) by Thu 5/20
- Redwood to provision evaluation endpoint and ingest pipeline by Mon 5/24
- Joint smoke test and measurement script run by Wed 5/26

Attachments: heliotech_poc_matrix.xlsx (POC action grid), sample_prompt_set.json (sample inputs), redwood_trial_config.yaml (runtime/quantization knobs)

If that all looks reasonable I'll queue the provisioning ticket and send calendar invites.

Hi Erin / Samir — quick technical follow-up based on the goals above. I sketched a lean evaluation plan so we can measure latency/throughput/cost with minimal infra changes on your side: 

Evaluation plan (technical)
- Phase 1 (sandbox, day 0–3): Redwood provides a hosted endpoint with sampling config and the shared test harness. We'll run 48h of baseline runs (single-concurrency, baseline model) to capture token distribution and cold-starts.
- Phase 2 (scale test, day 4–10): introduce batching, KV cache warmup, and quantized variant; ramp to target throughput (3 rps steady-state, bursts up to 12 rps). We'll capture p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput, and per-token cost.
- Phase 3 (quality eval, day 11–14): run blind human evaluations on 200 golden-labeled samples and compute acceptance rate + hallucination incidents.

Concrete measurement definitions
- Latency: measured server-side at Redwood (request received -> final token emitted). We'll report p50/p90/p99. Gate = p90 <= 850ms.
- Throughput: measured as sustained successful responses/sec across 15-minute windows.
- Cost/token: total billed token units / total output tokens (Redwood to provide cost breakout).
- Quality: blind human eval pass rate (accept/revise/reject labels) + automated hallucination heuristics.

Runbook and access
- I'll provision a temporary API key scoped to the sandbox (rotated after trial).
- We'll open a small S3 staging bucket for logs with 7-day retention.

Owners (technical)
- Redwood perf lead: Karthik (SE contact)
- Redwood infra ticket owner: Jonas (to coordinate any quota increases)
- HelioTech data lead: Samir (dataset, golden labels)

I attached a short config template and a draft test harness in the Drive link Jonas shared. If you sign the NDA today we can kick off provisioning tomorrow morning.
